IE 方法的演变
Methods for IE

Slide 4–5
  1. Rule-Based Approaches with manually engineered rules
    • rules defined over words/entities:
      “<company> located in <location>”
    • rules defined over parsed text:
      “(Subj:<company>) (Verb:located) (*) (Obj: <location>)”
  2. Traditional ML-Based Approaches
    • Supervised:
      • Train a relation classifier using labeled examples
      • Learns patterns automatically from annotated data
    • Partially-supervised:
      • bootstrap rules/patterns from “seed” examples
      • Iteratively discover new patterns and relations
  3. Deep Learning & Pre-trained Language Models
    • CNNs, RNNs, LSTMs
    • Transformer-based models
      • BERT, RoBERTa etc.
    • Fine-tune for:
      • Named Entity Recognition (NER), Relation Extraction (RE),
      • Event Extraction
  4. Large Language Models (LLMs)
    • GPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama, etc.
    • Information extraction via prompting
    • Zero-shot and few-shot extraction
    • Structured outputs (JSON, knowledge graphs)
    Example Prompt:
    "Extract all companies and headquarters locations from this text."

Rules → Traditional ML → Deep Learning → Pre-trained Transformers → LLM-based IE

IE 方法按时间分四代:

  1. 基于规则: 人工写规则. 规则可以定义在词和实体上 (「<公司> located in <地点>」: 一个公司名, 后接 located in, 再接一个地名, 就抽出「公司 – 所在地」关系), 也可以定义在句法分析结果上 (主语是公司、谓语是 located、宾语是地点, 中间允许任意成分 *). 后者不怕插入语, 因为它看的是句法关系而不是相邻词.
  2. 传统机器学习: supervised 有监督: 用标注好的例子训练一个关系分类器, 自动学出模式; partially-supervised 部分监督: 从少量「种子」例子出发 bootstrap 自举, 反复发现新模式、新关系 (Slide 44 的 BootCaT 是同一思路).
  3. 深度学习与预训练语言模型: CNN、RNN、LSTM, 后来是 Transformer (BERT、RoBERTa), 针对命名实体识别 (NER)、关系抽取 (RE)、事件抽取做 fine-tuning 微调.
  4. 大语言模型: 直接用 prompt 提示让模型抽取, 可以 zero-shot (不给例子) 或 few-shot (给几个例子), 输出结构化格式 (JSON、知识图谱). 例: 「从这段文本中抽取所有公司及其总部所在地.」
Slide 6
EraMain ideaLimitation
Rule-basedHandcrafted patternsExpensive to maintain
Traditional MLFeature engineeringDomain-dependent
Deep LearningLearned representationsNeeds labeled data
TransformersContextual representationsFine-tuning required
LLM-based IEPrompting + reasoningReliability & cost

每一代的核心思想和局限: 规则靠人工模式, 维护成本高 (每个新领域、新说法都要加规则); 传统机器学习靠特征工程 (人设计特征), 特征和领域绑定; 深度学习自动学表示, 但需要大量标注数据; Transformer 提供上下文相关的表示, 但每个任务还要微调; 基于 LLM 的 IE 靠提示加推理, 不用训练, 但结果不一定可靠 (可能编造), 而且调用成本高.

记忆方法: 每一代都在解决上一代的局限 (规则难维护 → 让机器学; 特征要人设计 → 让网络自己学表示; 标注数据不够 → 预训练; 每个任务要微调 → 直接提示), 同时带来新的局限.

IE 任务与场景
Relation Extraction: Disease Outbreaks · IE tasks · IE Scenarios

Slide 8–9

Relation Extraction: Disease Outbreaks (Back in 2005)

Relation Extraction: Disease Outbreaks (Now in 2026)

Slide from Manning via Fraser‘s slide deck

同一个关系抽取任务的两种做法. 输入是一篇 1995 年 5 月 19 日亚特兰大的新闻: 美国疾控中心 (CDC) 正处在应对扎伊尔致命埃博拉疫情的前线, 难以应付这场危机. 文中框出的三个信息就是要抽取的: 日期 (May 19 1995)、疾病 (Ebola)、地点 (Zaire).

  • 「2005 年」的做法 (标题里的年份指这种方法流行的年代, 不是新闻的年代): 信息抽取系统靠规则、gazetteer 地名词典 (已知实体的列表, 如所有国家名、疾病名) 和关系模式, 把结果填进一张三列的表 (Date, Disease Name, Location). 表里已有疟疾 (埃塞俄比亚)、疯牛病 (英国)、肺炎 (美国) 等记录.
  • 2026 年的做法: 直接给 LLM 一句提示「从文章中抽取疾病暴发, 输出 JSON」, 得到 {"disease": "Ebola", "location": "Zaire", "date": "May 1995"}.

输出的格式不同 (表 vs JSON), 但任务一样: 把非结构化文本变成结构化记录.

Slide 10

IE tasks

  • Many IE tasks are defined like this:
    • Get me a database like this
      • E.g. I want a database listing severe disease outbreaks by country and month/year
    • Then, find a corpus containing this information
    • And run IE on it

What to extract?

(Rechts die Tabelle von Slide 8, ergänzt um die Zeile „May 1995 · Ebola · Zaire“, rot markiert. Fraser‘s slide deck)

很多 IE 任务都是这样定义的: ① 先说清楚想要一个什么样的数据库 (例如: 按国家和年月列出的严重疾病暴发); ② 再找一个包含这些信息的语料; ③ 在语料上运行 IE. 也就是说, 先定「抽什么」, 再找「从哪抽」. 新抽到的 Ebola 记录被加进表里.

Slide 11

IE Scenarios : Traditional Information Extraction

This will be the main focus in the course

  • The templates we want is predefined
    • For our example: disease outbreaks
  • Instance types are predefined
    • For our example: diseases, locations, dates
  • Relation types are predefined
    • For our example, outbreak: when, what, where?
  • Corpus is often clearly specified
    • For our example: a newspaper corpus (e.g., the New York Times), with new articles appearing each day

Document Corpus ↓ Entity Recognition ↓ Relation Extraction ↓ Database

However, there are other interesting scenarios...

Fraser‘s slide deck

传统信息抽取是本课的重点. 它的特点是一切都预先定义:

  • Template 模板: 要填的记录格式 (疾病暴发);
  • 实例类型: 要识别哪些类别的实体 (疾病、地点、日期);
  • 关系类型: 实体之间的什么关系 (暴发: 何时、何病、何地);
  • 语料: 通常明确给定 (例如《纽约时报》这样每天有新文章的报纸语料).

处理流程是一条流水线: 文档语料 → Entity Recognition 实体识别 → Relation Extraction 关系抽取 → 数据库. 最后一句预告: 还有别的有趣场景 (Slide 24 起).

原文笔误: 「The templates we want is predefined」主语是复数, 应为 are.

信息检索与信息抽取
Basics : IR & IE · Information Retrieval

Slide 12–13

Basics : IR & IE

  • Information Retrieval (IR) vs. Information Extraction (IE)
    • Traditional IR
    • Web IR
    • IE
    • Non-traditional IE
      • Question Answering
      • Structured Summarization

Information Retrieval

  • Given an information need, find me documents that meet this need from a collection of documents
  • Traditional Information Retrieval (IR)
    • User has an "information need"
    • User formulates query to retrieval system
    • Query is used to return matching documents

Fraser‘s slide deck

这一节对比 Information Retrieval (IR) 信息检索和 Information Extraction (IE) 信息抽取, 顺序是: 传统 IR → 网络 IR → IE → 非传统 IE (问答、结构化摘要).

IR: 给定一个信息需求, 从文档集合里找出满足这个需求的文档. 传统 IR 的过程: 用户有信息需求 → 用户把需求写成查询 (query) 交给检索系统 → 系统用查询返回匹配的文档. 典型例子是搜索引擎和图书馆检索系统.

PDF S. 14

The Information Retrieval Cycle

Slide from J-Lin via Fraser‘s slide deck

信息检索循环 (原图来自 Jimmy Lin): 主线是 Source Selection 选源 (得到资源) → Query Formulation 写查询 (得到查询) → Search 检索 (得到 ranked list 排序列表) → Selection 挑选 (得到文档) → Examination 查看 (得到文档) → Delivery 交付.

两条反馈回路: 看过结果后, 必要时更新查询 (query reformulation 改写查询、vocabulary learning 学到更合适的用词、relevance feedback 相关反馈: 用户标记哪些结果相关, 系统据此调整), 必要时重新选源 (source reselection). 重点: 检索不是一次完成的, 是一个反复迭代的过程.

PDF S. 15

IR Test Collections

  • Three components of a test collection:
    • Collection of documents (corpus)
    • Set of information needs (topics)
    • Sets of documents that satisfy the information needs (relevance judgments)
  • Metrics for assessing “performance”
    • Precision, Recall
    • Other measures derived therefrom (e.g., F1)

(Rechts oben verkleinert der IR-Zyklus von PDF S. 14. Slide from J-Lin via Fraser‘s slide deck)

评测 IR 系统要有测试集, 由三部分组成: ① 文档集合 (语料); ② 一组信息需求 (称为 topics 主题); ③ 每个需求对应的相关文档集合 (relevance judgments 相关性判断, 即标准答案). 评价指标是 Precision 精确率、Recall 召回率, 以及由它们派生的指标, 如 F1.

Slide 17–18

RECAP: Toy example using n-gram overlaps

  • Unigrams: (I),(love),(Machine),(Learning)
  • Bigrams: (I love),(love Machine),(Machine Learning)

PRECISION = Overlapping number of n−grams / Number of n−grams in the candidate
RECALL = Overlapping number of n−grams / Number of n−grams in the reference
F1 = 2 × Precision × Recall / (Precision + Recall)

RECAP: Toy example

Candidate 1 : Summarization is cool
Reference 1 : Summarization is beneficial and cool

  • Precision = 3/3 = 1 — High Precision: Few mistakes
  • Recall = 3/5 = 0.6 — High Recall: Finds more relevant items
  • F1= 2*Recall*Precision/(Recall+Precision)= 2*(0.6)*(1)/((0.6)+1) = 0.75

复习 (第 1 周讲过): 用 n-gram 重叠来算精确率和召回率. 「I love Machine Learning」有 4 个 unigram 一元组、3 个 bigram 二元组.

  • Precision 精确率 = 重叠的 n-gram 数 ÷ 候选 (系统输出) 的 n-gram 数: 系统说的有多少是对的.
  • Recall 召回率 = 重叠的 n-gram 数 ÷ 参考 (标准答案) 的 n-gram 数: 该找到的找到了多少.
  • F1 = 两者的调和平均.

例: 候选「Summarization is cool」(3 个 unigram), 参考「Summarization is beneficial and cool」(5 个). 重叠的是 Summarization、is、cool, 共 3 个. 精确率 = 3/3 = 1 (候选里没有错词), 召回率 = 3/5 = 0.6 (漏了 beneficial 和 and), F1 = 2 · 0.6 · 1 / 1.6 = 0.75. 三个数都已用 Python 核对.

易错: 两者分子相同, 分母不同. 精确率高 = 错误少; 召回率高 = 遗漏少. 只输出一个最有把握的词可以让精确率 = 1, 但召回率很低, 所以要看 F1.

Slide 19–20

Where do the sources come from?

  • TREC = Text REtrieval Conferences
    • Series of annual evaluations, started in 1992
    • Organized into “tracks”
  • Test collections are formed by “pooling”
    • Gather results from all participants
    • Corpus/topics/judgments can be reused

But currently, the main source is the WEB, or in-house data!

Web Retrieval / WEB As Corpus

  • Traditional IR came out of the library sciences

(Zwei Infografiken: „2021 This Is What Happens In An Internet Minute“ und „The Internet in 2023 Every Minute“.)

These distributions have likely shifted substantially with the rise of mobile search, voice assistants, and LLM-based search experiences.

Slide from J-Lin via Fraser‘s slide deck

测试集从哪来? 经典来源是 TREC (文本检索会议): 从 1992 年起每年举办的评测, 按不同 track (赛道, 如问答、网页检索) 组织. 测试集用 pooling 汇集的方法构建: 把所有参赛系统返回的结果汇总, 只对这些文档做人工相关性判断 (不可能把整个语料都人工看一遍); 建好的语料、主题、判断可以反复使用.

但今天的主要来源是网络, 或机构内部的数据. 传统 IR 源自图书馆学; 网络检索的规模完全不同: 两张「互联网一分钟」信息图展示每分钟产生多少搜索、消息、视频等. 黄框的评论: 随着移动搜索、语音助手和基于 LLM 的搜索兴起, 这些分布很可能已经大幅变化.

PDF S. 20

Information Retrieval (IR)

  • Important assumption:
    can substitute “document” for “information”
  • IR systems (traditional)
    • Use statistical methods
    • Rely on the frequency of words in query, document, collection
      Better represented with distributional semantic methods!
    • Retrieve complete documents
    • Return ranked lists of “hits” based on relevance
  • Limitations
    • Answers information need indirectly
    • Does not attempt to understand the “meaning” of user’s query or documents in the collection
    • SOTE LLM IR is more advanced in that sense too!

Slide from J-Lin via Fraser‘s slide deck

IR 的一个重要假设: 可以用「文档」代替「信息」, 即找到包含信息的文档就算满足了需求.

传统 IR 系统: 用统计方法; 依赖词在查询、文档、整个集合中的频率 (如 TF-IDF; 绿字补充: 用分布式语义方法, 即词向量, 表示会更好); 返回完整文档; 按相关度返回「命中」的排序列表.

局限: 只间接回答信息需求 (给你文档, 答案要自己读出来); 不试图理解查询和文档的含义 (只看词形是否匹配). 绿字: 当前最先进的基于 LLM 的检索在这方面也更进一步.

原文笔误: 「SOTE LLM IR」应为 SOTA (state of the art, 最先进的).

信息抽取的特点
IE Scenarios (Cont.) · Information Extraction (IE)

Slide 24

IE Scenarios (Cont.)

Non-traditional IE

  • Two interesting IE scenarios
    • Question answering
    • Structured summarization
  • Open IE
    • IE without predefined templates!
    • Will cover this at the end of the semester

Fraser‘s slide deck

非传统 IE: ① 两个有趣的场景: 问答和结构化摘要 (Slide 27–30); ② Open IE 开放信息抽取: 不预先定义模板 (也不预先定义关系类型), 从文本中抽出任意的 (主语, 关系, 宾语) 三元组, 学期末再讲.

Slide 25–26

Information Extraction (IE)

  • Information Extraction is very different from Information Retrieval
    • Convert documents to database entries
    • Usually process entire corpus
  • Once you have the database/corpus
    • An analyst can do further manual analysis
    • Automatic analysis ("data mining")
    • Can also be presented to end-user in a specialized browsing or search interface
      • For instance, concert listings crawled from music club websites (Eventim, Spotify etc)
  • IE systems
    • Identify documents of a specific type
    • Extract information according to pre-defined templates
    • Place the information into frame-like database records
  • Templates = sort of like pre-defined questions
  • Extracted information = answers
  • Limitations
    • Templates are domain dependent and not easily portable
    • One size does not fit all!

(Rechts oben die Tabelle von Slide 10. Slide modified from J. Lin)

IE 和 IR 很不一样:

IR 信息检索IE 信息抽取
输出文档 (的排序列表)数据库记录
处理范围针对一个查询, 返回相关的几篇通常处理整个语料
怎样回答需求间接 (用户自己读)直接 (答案就是字段的值)

得到数据库之后可以: 分析师人工分析; 自动分析 (data mining 数据挖掘); 或者做成专门的浏览、搜索界面给最终用户, 例如从音乐俱乐部网站抓取的演出信息.

IE 系统的三步: ① 识别特定类型的文档; ② 按预定义的模板抽取信息; ③ 把信息放进类似框架 (frame) 的数据库记录. 打个比方: 模板 = 预先定好的问题, 抽取到的信息 = 答案. 局限: 模板依赖领域、不容易移植 (疾病暴发的模板对演出信息毫无用处), 没有一种模板适合所有情况.

问答与结构化摘要
Question answering · Structured Summarization

Slide 27

Question answering

  • Question answering can be loosely viewed as "just-in-time" Information Extraction
    • Some question types are easy to think of as IE templates, but some are not
“Factoid”Who discovered Oxygen?
When did Hawaii become a state?
Where is Deutsches Museum located?
What team won the World Series in 1992?
“List”What countries export oil?
Name German cities that have a “Cirque Du Soleil” show.
What countries stopped using nuclear energy?
“Definition”Who is Astor Piazzolla?
What is a ChatGPT?

Different IE needs for different question types!!!

Slide from J. Lin

Question Answering (QA) 问答可以粗略看成「即时的 (just-in-time)」信息抽取: 不是事先把整个语料抽成数据库, 而是有问题时才去抽. 有的问题类型很容易看成 IE 模板, 有的不容易.

  • Factoid 事实型: 答案是一个短事实 (人、时间、地点、组织). 谁发现了氧? 夏威夷何时成为美国的州? 德意志博物馆在哪里? 1992 年谁赢得了世界大赛 (美国棒球)? 这类最像 IE 模板: 填一个槽.
  • List 列表型: 答案是一组实体, 要从多处汇总: 哪些国家出口石油? 哪些德国城市有太阳马戏团的演出? 哪些国家停用了核能?
  • Definition 定义型: 答案是一段描述, 很难套进固定模板: Astor Piazzolla 是谁 (阿根廷探戈作曲家)? ChatGPT 是什么?

结论: 不同的问题类型需要不同的 IE 能力.

幻灯片小错: 「What is a ChatGPT?」: ChatGPT 是专有名词, 不加冠词, 应为「What is ChatGPT?」.

Slide 28–29

An Example

Who won the Nobel Peace Prize in 1991?

But many foreign investors remain sceptical, and western governments are withholding aid because of the Slorc's dismal human rights record and the continued detention of Ms Aung San Suu Kyi, the opposition leader who won the Nobel Peace Prize in 1991.
The military junta took power in 1988 as pro-democracy demonstrations were sweeping the country. It held elections in 1990, but has ignored their result. It has kept the 1991 Nobel peace prize winner, Aung San Suu Kyi - leader of the opposition party which won a landslide victory in the poll - under house arrest since July 1989.
The regime, which is also engaged in a battle with insurgents near its eastern border with Thailand, ignored a 1990 election victory by an opposition party and is detaining its leader, Ms Aung San Suu Kyi, who was awarded the 1991 Nobel Peace Prize. According to the British Red Cross, 5,000 or more refugees, mainly the elderly and women and children, are crossing into Bangladesh each day.

Central Idea of Factoid QA

  • Determine the semantic type of the expected answer
    “Who won the Nobel Peace Prize in 1991?” is looking for a PERSON
  • Retrieve documents that have keywords from the question
  • Look for named-entities of the proper type near keywords
    Retrieve documents that have the keywords “won”, “Nobel Peace Prize”, and “1991”
  • Look for a PERSON near the keywords “won”, “Nobel Peace Prize”, and “1991”

(In den Textausschnitten sind „won“, „Nobel Peace Prize“ und „1991“ rot hervorgehoben. Slide from J. Lin)

例子: 「谁获得了 1991 年诺贝尔和平奖?」三段新闻 (关于缅甸军政府 SLORC) 里都出现了答案 昂山素季 (Aung San Suu Kyi, 反对党领袖, 1991 年获奖, 1989 年 7 月起被软禁; 这些事实都对).

事实型问答的核心思路:

  1. 判断期望答案的语义类型: 「Who …」要找的是一个 PERSON (人);
  2. 检索包含问题关键词 (won、Nobel Peace Prize、1991) 的文档 (这一步就是 IR);
  3. 在关键词附近找类型合适的命名实体: 在 won、Nobel Peace Prize、1991 旁边找一个人名 (这一步就是 IE).

所以事实型 QA = IR + 命名实体识别 + 就近匹配. 三段文字说法各不相同 (won / winner / was awarded), 但答案都在关键词附近, 多处出现也增加了答案的可信度.

Slide 30–32

Structured Summarization

  • Typical automatic summarization task is to take as input an article, and return a short text summary
    • Old systems often just choose sentences (reformulating sentences was difficult!)
    • New systems generate the summarization
  • A structured summarization task might be to take a company website, say, www.inxight.com, and return something like this:
Company Name:   Inxight
Founded:        1997
History:        Spun out from Xerox PARC Business
Focus:          Information Discovery from Unstructured Data Sources
Industry Focus: Enterprise, Government, Publishing, Pharma/Life Sciences, Financial Services, OEM
Solutions:      Based on 20+ years of research at Xerox PARC
Customers:      300 global 2000 customers
Patents:        70 in information visualization, natural language processing, information retrieval
Headquarters:   Sunnyvale, CA
Offices:        Sunnyvale, Minneapolis, New York, Washington DC, London, Munich, Boston, Boulder, Antwerp
  • We discussed two interesting IE scenarios
    • Question answering
    • Structured summarization
  • There are many more, as we will discuss in the rest of the semester.

How current LLMs changed IE?

  • Extraction via prompting
  • Structured JSON outputs
  • Retrieval-Augmented Generation
  • Agent-based workflows

普通的自动摘要: 输入一篇文章, 输出一小段文字. 旧系统多是抽取式 (从原文挑句子, 因为改写句子太难), 新系统是生成式 (自己写摘要).

结构化摘要: 输入一个公司网站, 输出一张「字段: 值」的卡片 (公司名、成立年份、历史、业务重点、客户、专利、总部、办公地点). 这本质上就是 IE: 字段 = 模板, 值 = 抽取结果. 例子里的 Inxight 是 1997 年从施乐帕洛阿尔托研究中心 (Xerox PARC) 分拆出来的文本分析公司.

LLM 怎样改变了 IE: ① 用提示直接抽取; ② 直接输出结构化 JSON; ③ RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) 检索增强生成: 先检索相关文档, 再让模型基于这些文档回答, 正是「IR + 抽取」的现代版本; ④ 基于智能体 (agent) 的工作流: 模型自己决定何时搜索、调用工具、多步完成抽取.

第二部分: 为信息抽取获取数据
Part 2: Obtaining Data for Information Extraction · Source selection / WEB as corpus

Slide 33–34

Part 2: Obtaining Data for Information Extraction
Source selection / WEB as corpus

Finding the Sources

(Grafik: Dokument → „?“ → Information Extraction → Tabelle)

  • How can we find the documents to extract information from?
  • The document collection can be given a priori
    • Closed Information Extraction)
    • E.g. a specific document (such as a user manual), all files on my computer, all articled published in the ACL Anthology etc.
  • We can aim to extract information from the entire WEB
    • Open Information Extraction
    • How can we do that? We need to crawl the Web
  • The system can find by itself the source documents
    • E.g. by using search engines, or other IR tools

Slide from Suchanek

第二部分: 抽取之前, 先要有数据源. 从哪里得到要抽取的文档? 三种情况:

  1. 文档集合事先给定 (这里称为 closed IE, 封闭式): 例如一份用户手册、我电脑上的所有文件、ACL Anthology (计算语言学论文库) 里的所有论文.
  2. 从整个网络抽取 (这里称为 open IE): 需要自己爬取 (crawl) 网络.
  3. 系统自己找源文档: 例如用搜索引擎或其他 IR 工具.

幻灯片前后不一致: Slide 24 把 Open IE 定义为「没有预定义模板的 IE」(抽取任意关系, 这是文献中的通常含义, 如 TextRunner、ReVerb); 这里 (取自 Suchanek 的课件) 却用 Open / Closed IE 指数据源是整个网络还是事先给定的集合. 两者是不同维度: 也可以在固定文档集合上做 Open IE. 考试中说 Open IE, 默认指 Slide 24 的含义.

原文笔误: 「Closed Information Extraction)」多了一个右括号; 「all articled published」应为 articles; 最后还有一个空的列表项.

Slide 35–36

What is a corpus?

Corpora are "collections of language samples produced in natural contexts and without experimental interferences" (Baroni & Ueyama, 2006)

Use in linguistics and NLP:

  • provide evidence for theoretical and applied linguistics questions
  • simulate language acquisition
  • lexicography (write and compile dictionaries)
  • language modelling
  • and more generally, data-driven linguistics and computational linguistics

Why use the Web as corpus?

  • huge quantity of textual data (also multimodal)
  • constantly evolving
  • many languages (perhaps even ALL written languages) and sub-languages

Baroni, M. & Ueyama, M. (2006), Building general- and special-purpose corpora by Web crawling, in 'Proceedings of the 13th NIJL International Symposium, Language Corpora: Their Compilation and Application', pp. 31-40. — Chris Biemann‘s Slide Deck

Korpus 语料库: 「在自然语境中产生、没有实验干预的语言样本的集合」. 关键是自然: 不是为实验专门诱导出来的句子. 用途: 为语言学问题提供证据、模拟语言习得、编词典、训练语言模型, 以及一般的数据驱动语言学和计算语言学.

为什么用网络当语料: 数据量巨大 (还有图片、视频等多模态数据); 不断更新 (新词、新话题); 语言多 (也许包括所有有文字的语言) 以及各种子语言 (专业语域、方言、网络用语).

Quelle: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Languages_used_on_the_Internet)

网络上各语言所占比例 (按网站的内容语言统计): 英语占绝对多数 (图中 60%), 其次是俄语、西班牙语等, 德语约 3%, 中文只有 1%. 这说明网络语料语言分布极不均衡: 小语种的网络数据少得多, 用网络数据训练的模型对它们效果也更差.

注意中文比例低是因为统计的是「网站」(W3Techs 统计的是访问量前 1000 万的网站), 大量中文内容在封闭平台和 App 里, 没有被统计到.

版本差异: 图中数据较旧 (约 2020 年前后的 W3Techs 统计). 据维基百科引用的 W3Techs 数据, 2025 年 12 月英语约占 49.3%, 西班牙语约 6.0%, 俄语约 3.7%; 英语已不到 60%, 俄语也不再是第二.

Slide 38

Pros and cons for using the Web as corpus

Pros:

  • Size
  • Allows fast and cheap construction of corpora
  • Variety of genres, including blogs, interactive communication, social media, video comments

Cons

  • Noise: duplicates, non-linguistic material
  • Automatic corpus construction techniques make it difficult to control the composition of the corpora obtained (lack of metadata)
  • Copyright issues
  • Non-native contributors
  • NEW AI generated text

Chris Biemann‘s Slide Deck

优点缺点
规模大噪声: 重复内容、非语言材料 (代码、菜单、表格)
能快速、低成本地建语料自动构建难以控制语料的构成 (缺少元数据: 不知道作者、体裁、年代)
Genre 体裁多样: 博客、互动交流、社交媒体、视频评论版权问题
非母语者写的文本
新问题: AI 生成的文本 (用它训练模型会让模型「吃自己的输出」, 质量下降)

把网络当语料的三种经典方法
Classical Approaches to the Web as a linguistic corpus

Slide 39

Classical Approaches to the Web as a linguistic corpus (Baroni & Ueyama, 2006)

  1. Use hit counts provided by a commercial search engine as frequency estimates
    • hits("the most torpid heart") = 4
    • hits("the most invidious heart“) = 0
    • hits("the most stolid heart“) = 6
    • hits("the most obdurate heart“) = 1240

    Unlikely collocations (Sumita et al., 2005) !

  2. Build corpora through search engine queries
  3. Linguistic crawls of the Web

Chris Biemann‘s Slide Deck

Baroni 和 Ueyama (2006) 总结了三种经典方法:

  1. 用商业搜索引擎给出的命中数 (hit counts) 当作频率估计. 例: 四个形容词 + heart 的搭配, 命中数从 0 到 1240 不等, 可以据此判断哪个搭配最自然 (obdurate heart「冷酷的心」最常见). 这类例子来自 Sumita 等 (2005) 用网络频率给英语填空题挑干扰项的研究: 命中数很低的搭配是「不太可能的搭配」, 适合当错误选项.
  2. 通过搜索引擎查询来建语料.
  3. 自己做语言学爬取 (爬虫).
Slide 40–42

Classical Method 1: Using hit counts

This information changes rapidly over time

Estimates might be unreliable

  • Impossible to reproduce
  • Impossible to apply in a static environment

The dominant collocation is (not surprisingly) stable

  • But e.g. threshold ratios based on these hit counts might get unreliable/outdated, count ratios fluctuate
  • APIs retrieve different values than “real” web search

Counts are approximate

(Screenshot einer Google-Suche nach "the most invidious heart": „About 3 results (0.17 seconds)“.)

"We try to be very clear that our results estimates are just that– estimates. In theory we could spend cycles on that aspect of our system, but in practice we have a lot of other things to work on, and more accurate results estimates is lower on the list than lots of other things." — Matt Cutts, Head of Google’s spam team

"Why is Googleology bad science?"

  • Only very simple queries are possible (no easy way of regular expression use, no lemmatisation or POS tagging of the documents and queries)
  • Constraints on the numbers of queries per day
  • Results are not reproducible since the index constantly changes
  • Counts are usually unreliable and arbitrary:
  • internal workings and optimizations of search engines are proprietary and often not tuned towards the needs of computational linguistics

Kilgarriff, A. (2007), 'Googleology is Bad Science', Computational Linguistics 33(1), 147-151. — Chris Biemann‘s Slide Deck

命中数方法的问题:

  • 数字随时间快速变化, 估计不可靠: 无法复现, 也无法在离线 (静态) 环境中使用.
  • 最强的搭配 (谁排第一) 通常稳定, 但基于命中数的阈值、比例会过时、波动; 通过 API 得到的数字和网页搜索显示的也不一样.
  • 命中数只是估计值: Slide 39 说「the most invidious heart」命中 0 次, 截图里 Google 却显示「约 3 条结果」. Google 反垃圾团队负责人 Matt Cutts 也说: 结果数只是估计, 提高它的精度在我们的优先级列表上很靠后.

Kilgarriff (2007) 的文章《谷歌学是糟糕的科学》总结: 只能做很简单的查询 (不能用正则表达式, 没有词形还原和词性标注); 每天的查询次数有限; 索引不断变化, 结果无法复现; 计数不可靠、随意; 搜索引擎的内部机制是商业机密, 并不为计算语言学的需要而设计.

Slide 43–44

Classical Method 2: Building corpora using search engine queries

  • Issue automated queries to the search engine
  • Retrieve the pages returned by the search engine (Information Retrieval)
  • Process the pages to build a corpus (Information Extraction)

The corpora obtained are quite good in terms of the distribution of genres and topics

—The approach does not rely on a search engine for counts
But:
— The pages retrieved depend on the search engine ranking
— The method depends on the availability of search APIs

BootCaT Method

M. Baroni and S. Bernardini. 2004. BootCaT: Bootstrapping corpora and terms from the web. Proceedings of LREC 2004, Lisbon: ELDA. 1313-1316.

Chris Biemann‘s Slide Deck

方法 2: 用搜索引擎查询建语料. 自动向搜索引擎发查询 → 下载返回的网页 (这一步是 IR) → 处理网页, 建成语料 (这一步是 IE). 得到的语料在体裁和话题分布上相当好; 它不依赖搜索引擎的计数. 缺点: 下载到哪些页面取决于搜索引擎的排序; 方法依赖搜索 API 是否可用 (现在很多 API 收费或关闭了).

BootCaT (Baroni & Bernardini 2004) 是这种方法的代表, 用于建专业领域语料:

  1. 准备目标领域的种子词 (如火山学: éruption, volcan, lave);
  2. 把种子词随机组合成查询 (如「éruption volcan lave」);
  3. 用搜索引擎 API 收集这些查询返回的 URL;
  4. 得到 URL 列表, 下载网页并清洗 HTML;
  5. 从得到的文本中抽取新的种子词 (该领域特有的高频词), 回到第 2 步.

Bootstrapping 自举 (图中定义): 从一小部分初始信息出发, 迭代地增加学到的信息量. 和 Slide 4 部分监督 IE 的「从种子例子自举模式」是同一思想.

Slide 45

Classical Method 3: Use a linguistic crawler

  • Perform your own crawl of the Web
  • Not dependent on any commercial search engine
  • Most difficult approach to implement
    • Considerable computational resources needed to perform the crawl
    • hard to achieve unbiased link collection in the crawler
    • Cleaning of the data in absence of search engine quality filter
    • Annotating the data: POS tagging, lemmatisation

M. Baroni, S. Bernardini, A. Ferraresi and E. Zanchetta. 2009. The WaCky Wide Web: A Collection of Very Large Linguistically Processed Web-Crawled Corpora. Language Resources and Evaluation 43(3): 209-226
Biemann, C. and Heyer, G. and Quasthoff, U. and Richter, M. (2007) The Leipzig Corpora Collection - Monolingual corpora of standard size. Proceedings of Corpus Linguistic 2007, Birmingham, UK

方法 3: 自己写爬虫. 不依赖任何商业搜索引擎, 但实现最难: 爬取需要大量计算资源; 爬虫很难无偏地收集链接 (总会偏向链接多的大网站); 没有搜索引擎的质量过滤, 清洗要自己做; 还要自己标注数据 (词性标注、词形还原). 代表成果: WaCky 语料 (如德语的 deWaC、英语的 ukWaC, 每个十亿词以上) 和莱比锡语料库集 (Leipzig Corpora Collection).

数据清洗
Cleaning up the data

Slide 46–48

Cleaning up the data

Data Cleaning

  • Web spam filtering
  • HTML file pre-processing
  • Content extraction
  • Duplicate removal
  • Content cleaning and filtering: smileys, spelling errors, etc.
  • Language identification

Additional Data Cleaning in the LLM Era

  • Deduplication
  • AI-generated content filtering
  • Synthetic data detection
  • Watermarking
  • Crawl quality assessment

Filtering of undesirable material

  • Web spam: artificially constructed pages used to influence search engine rankings
  • Splogs (spam blogs): artificially created blog sites used to influence search engine rankings
  • Spam in blogs (blog spam, comment spam): automatic posting of random comments or advertisements including links to blogs
  • Automatically generated pages (e.g. from eBay, Amazon, etc.)
  • Web directories: list of web sites sorted by category

http://nononprofitspam.wordpress.com/

网络数据要经过一系列清洗: 过滤垃圾网页 → 预处理 HTML → 抽取正文 → 去重 → 清理内容 (表情符号、拼写错误等) → 识别语言. 本节后面按这个顺序讲.

LLM 时代新增的清洗: 更彻底的去重 (重复数据会让模型背诵训练集); 过滤 AI 生成的内容; 检测合成数据; Watermarking 水印 (在生成文本里嵌入可检测的统计标记, 便于以后识别并过滤); 评估爬取数据的质量.

要过滤的不良材料: Web spam 网页垃圾 (为操纵搜索排名而人工制造的网页); Splog 垃圾博客; 博客中的垃圾评论 (自动发布带链接的随机评论或广告); 自动生成的页面 (如电商网站按模板生成的商品页); 网站目录 (按类别排列的网址列表). 共同点: 不是自然产生的语言, 不符合 Slide 35 对语料的定义.

Slide 49–51

HTML File cleaning

  • This is a "low-level, unglamourous task" (Kilgarriff, 2007)
  • Yet crucial and quite tricky
  • Boilerplate removal
    • Boilerplate = "canned or automatically generated text blocks including navigation bars, page headers, link lists, disclaimers and copyright statements, as well as the ubiquitous advertisements" (Evert, 2007)
  • Methods:
    • Use of HTML structure
    • Use of HTML tags
    • Use of language models

HTML File Cleaning: preprocessing

HTML 清洗是「底层、不光鲜的工作」(Kilgarriff), 但至关重要, 也相当棘手. 核心是 Boilerplate removal 去除样板文字: 样板 = 「现成的或自动生成的文字块, 包括导航栏、页眉、链接列表、免责声明和版权声明, 以及无处不在的广告」(Evert 2007). 方法: 利用 HTML 结构 (DOM 树)、HTML 标签 (如 <nav>、<footer>)、语言模型 (正文更像自然语言).

预处理的五步 (左栏): ① 检测框架 (frames: 一个页面由几个子页面拼成); ② 检测文件编码 (见本章后面的编码一节); ③ 清理 HTML 代码; ④ 把命名和数字 HTML 实体转换成字符 (&egrave; → è, &#233; → é); ⑤ 抽取文档的正文.

右边的两个网页说明要区分的区域: 只有标成 Contents 的部分是要的正文, 网站标题、广告、链接、版权、上一篇/下一篇都要去掉; 新闻页里还有图片和视频 (多模态内容), 做多模态 IE 时它们反而要保留.

Slide 52–53

Relevant content extraction

  • Web pages contain a lot more information than what is needed / required for web corpus building:
    • Copyright information
    • Links to other pages within the same site
    • Menu and navigation items
    • Advertisements
  • Problem: Pages from different sites have different structure
    • Simple methods based on regular expressions are not generic enough
    • Exhaustive definitions of patterns per page is not feasible

Scraping Tools

  • Scrapy (https://scrapy.org/) • Language: Python • extracts data efficiently from websites, processes them, and store them in various formats(JSON, XML, and CSV).
  • Beautiful Soup is a Python library for pulling data out of HTML and XML files.
  • browser automation (Playwright/Selenium)
  • a chrome extension that helps you to perform online research and get data into CSV file quickly.
  • Browse AI, Octoparse (Very easy to use, no programming required, good for small projects and demonstrations.

(Logos von Scrapy, Beautiful Soup, Playwright, Selenium und einer Chrome-Erweiterung.)

相关内容抽取: 网页里有很多建语料用不到的东西 (版权信息、站内链接、菜单导航、广告). 难点是不同网站的结构各不相同: 基于正则表达式的简单方法不够通用, 为每种页面穷举定义模式也不现实. 所以实际中常用基于统计或机器学习的正文抽取工具 (如 jusText、trafilatura).

抓取工具:

  • Scrapy: Python 爬虫框架, 高效抓取、处理并存成 JSON、XML、CSV;
  • Beautiful Soup: Python 库, 从 HTML / XML 文件中提取数据 (解析已下载的页面);
  • Playwright / Selenium: 浏览器自动化, 用于需要执行 JavaScript 才能显示内容的页面;
  • 浏览器扩展、Browse AI、Octoparse: 无需编程, 适合小项目和演示.

去重
Duplicate removal · Near-duplicate detection

Slide 54

Duplicate removal

Simplest case: perfect duplicates, i.e. the same Web page is available from different URLs

  • FAQ (Frequently Asked Questions) or RFC (Request For Comments)
  • The online documentation for popular programs.
  • Legal documents

Near-duplicates:

  • Mostly the same content
  • Different layout and design

Partial duplicates:

  • Quotations
  • Copy and paste of text from another Web pages
  • Mashups

! On web scale, it is not possible to pair-wisely check all documents!

三种重复:

  • 完全重复: 同一网页能从不同 URL 访问到, 如 FAQ、RFC (互联网标准文档)、流行软件的在线文档、法律文本 (被大量网站转载).
  • Near-duplicate 近似重复: 内容基本相同, 排版和设计不同.
  • 部分重复: 引文、从别的网页复制粘贴的段落、mashup 混搭页 (把几个来源的内容拼成一页).

关键难点: 在网络规模下不可能两两比较所有文档. n 篇文档要比较 n(n−1)/2 对, 十亿篇就是约 5 × 1017 对.

Slide 55

Near-duplicate detection

  • Shingling algorithm (Broder et al., 1997)
    • A shingle is a sequence of k consecutive terms.
  • define the k-shingles of document d to be the set of all consecutive sequences of k terms in d.
  • compute shingle fingerprint of each document
  • compute super-shingles by shingling over the shingles
  • only compare documents that share a super-shingle

Broder, A. Z.; Glassman, S. C.; Manasse, M. S. & Zweig, G. (1997), Syntactic clustering of the Web, in 'Selected papers from the sixth international conference on World Wide Web', Elsevier Science Publishers Ltd., Essex, UK, pp. 1157—1166.

Shingling 瓦片算法 (Broder 等 1997): 一个 shingle 是 k 个连续的词 (像屋顶瓦片一样一片压一片); 文档 d 的 k-shingle 集合就是 d 中所有连续 k 个词的序列. 图中 k = 3: 9 个词的句子有 9 − 3 + 1 = 7 个 shingle (The quick brown, quick brown fox, …, the lazy dog), 每个算出一个哈希值 (指纹).

步骤: ① 计算每篇文档的 shingle 指纹集合; ② 在 shingle 上再做一次 shingling, 得到 super-shingle 超级瓦片; ③ 只比较至少共享一个超级瓦片的文档. 这样就不用两两比较所有文档 (下两张幻灯片是玩具例子).

Slide 56–57

Shingles (toy example)

Document A: information extraction methods are crucial

  • information extraction methods → 84
  • extraction methods are → 99
  • methods are crucial → → 91

Document B: information extraction methods are important

  • information extraction methods → 84
  • extraction methods are → 99
  • methods are important → 34

The proportion of shared shingles can be measured using Jaccard similarity: J(A, B) = | A ∩ B | / | A ∪ B |

Create Super-Shingles (toy example)

fingerprints of fingerprints

  • 84, 99,→ hash → A12
  • 12, 34) → hash → B57
  • Instead of comparing all document pairs, we can check shared super-shingles.
  • Since Document A and Document B share one super shingle A12 , they become a candidate pair, only after then we compute the expensive similarity measure.

Not this original form but updated versions (MinHash/LSH, SimHash are still in use!

两个只差最后一个词的句子, 各有 3 个 3-shingle, 用数字代表它们的哈希值. 共享 84 和 99, 各自独有 91 和 34. Jaccard 相似度 = 交集大小 / 并集大小 = |{84, 99}| / |{84, 99, 91, 34}| = 2/4 = 0.5 (已用 Python 按真实的 3-gram 集合核对).

超级瓦片 = 「指纹的指纹」: 把相邻的 shingle 指纹再组合起来求哈希. A 的指纹序列 (84, 99, 91) 和 B 的 (84, 99, 34) 都含有组合 (84, 99), 求哈希得到同一个超级瓦片 A12, 所以 A 和 B 成为候选对; 只有候选对才计算昂贵的相似度. 不共享任何超级瓦片的文档对直接跳过, 这就是省时间的地方.

原始的 shingling 现在已不直接使用, 但它的改进版仍在用: MinHash + LSH (局部敏感哈希: 快速近似 Jaccard 相似度并分桶) 和 SimHash (把文档压成一个指纹, 相似文档的指纹只差几位).

幻灯片错误: 超级瓦片的两行「84, 99,→ hash → A12」和「12, 34) → hash → B57」括号不全, 第二行的数字也对不上: 前面的 shingle 指纹里没有 12. 按上面的指纹, 应为 (84, 99) → A12 (A 和 B 共有), 以及 (99, 91) 和 (99, 34) (分别是 A、B 独有的组合). 另外「methods are crucial → → 91」多了一个箭头.

Slide 58–59

Embedding-Based Near Duplicate Detection (Modern Approach)

Sentence-BERT (SBERT)
Convert each document into a dense vector

Document ↓ Embedding Model ↓ 768-dimensional vector

Similarity measured using:

  • Cosine similarity
  • Euclidean distance

Advantages:

  • Detects paraphrases
  • Robust to wording changes

LLM-Based Semantic Deduplication

LLMs can judge:

  • Duplicate
  • Near duplicate
  • Contradiction
  • Paraphrase

Example prompt:
Are these two documents semantically equivalent despite wording differences?

Much more expensive than embeddings but sometimes used for final verification.

基于嵌入的近似重复检测 (现代方法): 用 Sentence-BERT 这类模型把每篇文档变成一个稠密向量 (例如 768 维; 具体维数取决于模型, 小模型如 all-MiniLM-L6-v2 是 384 维), 用余弦相似度或欧氏距离比较. 优点: 能发现改写 (paraphrase), 对换词不敏感. 对比: shingling 只看字面重叠, 换几个同义词 Jaccard 就会大降; 嵌入看的是语义.

基于 LLM 的语义去重: 让 LLM 判断两篇文档是重复、近似重复、矛盾还是改写. 比嵌入贵得多, 有时只用于最后的确认.

三种方法的取舍: 一般先用便宜的方法 (MinHash) 在全量数据上筛出候选, 再用较贵的嵌入或 LLM 精查少量候选, 与 Slide 57「先找候选对, 再算昂贵的相似度」是同一思路.

文本内容的清洗
Cleaning up text contents for NLP

Slide 60

Cleaning up text contents for NLP

  • Irrational use of only uppercase or lowercase letters
  • Irrational use of punctuation marks and other symbols, e.g. !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! or ???????????!!!!!
  • Other problems: smileys, internet short forms, ...

Figure 1: Car-blog text, whole text in lower case

i have purchased aveo1.4 in …
over 6000kms.in city it is g…
but on highway it is giving…
car.fine riding comfort.gears…
even with ac.interiors r very…

Figure 2: Figure 1 text corrected

I have purchased aveo1.4 in july 2007.
So far I have driven over 6000kms.
In city it is giving a low mileage of 9to10 km but on highway it is giving 14 with a/c on.
It is smooth car.
Fine riding comfort.
Gears r smooth.
A very silent engine even with ac.
Interiors r very attractive.

Dey, L. & Haque, S. K. M. (2008), Opinion mining from noisy text data, in 'AND '08: Proceedings of the second workshop on Analytics for noisy unstructured text data', ACM, New York, NY, USA, pp. 83--90.

网络文本本身也要清理: 不合理地全用大写或全用小写; 滥用标点和符号 (一长串感叹号、问号); 表情符号、网络缩写等.

例子是一篇汽车博客 (Dey & Haque 2008, 用于从噪声文本做观点挖掘): 原文全小写、句号后不空格 (「6000kms.in city」), 很难分句. 修正后每句首字母大写、分句清楚. 注意修正版仍保留了网络缩写 「r」(= are) 和「ac」(= air conditioning), 说明清洗是分层次的: 先恢复大小写和句子边界, 缩写规范化是另一步 (Slide 64).

幻灯片排版问题: Figure 2 的框压在 Figure 1 和下面的文献出处上, Figure 1 每行的后半截和出处的后半截被遮住 (上面用「…」标出被遮住的部分). 完整文本见 Figure 2.

Slide 61–62

Orthographic errors

  • There are many orthographic and grammatical errors in Web documents
  • Errors in corpora and linguistic knowledge bases automatically retrieved from the Web can be problematic for applications such as computer-assisted language learning
  • Kinds of errors
    • Typing errors
    • Spelling errors (insufficient language competence)
    • Inadequate character encoding
    • OCR errors

Ringlstetter, C.; Schulz, K. U. & Mihov, S. (2006), 'Orthographic Errors in Web Pages: Toward Cleaner Web Corpora', Computational Linguistics 32(3), 295—340.

网页里有大量拼写和语法错误. 从网络自动构建的语料和语言知识库如果含错, 对计算机辅助语言学习这类应用尤其有害 (学习者会学到错的形式). 错误种类: 打字错误 (手误); 拼写错误 (语言能力不足, 真的不知道怎么写); 字符编码错误 (如 ü 显示成 Ã¼); OCR 错误 (扫描识别错).

表 6 (Ringlstetter 等 2006) 列出常见的德语拼写错误及其 Google 命中数. 结论在最下面: 仅靠频率阈值无法区分错拼和正确词. 例: 错拼 vorraus 有 214 000 次命中, 比正确词 ekelig (20 600) 多十倍; Addresse 有 67.6 万次. 如果规定「出现超过 N 次就算正确词」, 这些错拼都会混进词表.

幻灯片错误: Kamera 一行的变换写成「mm → m」, 方向反了. 其他各行都是「正确拼写 → 错误拼写」(如 Weihnachten 的 ih → i 得到 Weinachten), Kamera → Kammera 是把 m 写成了 mm, 应为 m → mm. (这一行照搬自原论文的表.) 另外最后一句「missspellings」多了一个 s, 应为 misspellings.

  • Newspaper text corpus (Gigaword) vs. Web corpus
  • Misspellings only represent a small proportion of the tokens (5.6M / 699M in the Web corpus), but a large number of types

把新闻语料 (Gigaword) 和网络语料比较: 错拼在词例 (token) 中只占很小比例 (网络语料约 5.6M / 669M, 不到 1%), 但在词型 (type) 中数量很多: 每个错拼都是一个新的词型. 表中 receive 的各种错拼: 新闻语料平均每个词典词有 1.7 种错拼, 网络语料有 3.7 种. 所以错拼会大大膨胀词表, 影响词频统计和语言模型.

复习 token 与 type: token 是文本中出现的每个词 (计重复), type 是不同的词形 (不计重复).

幻灯片前后不一致: 正文写网络语料是「5.6M / 699M」, 表里网络语料一栏是「5.6m misspellings in 669m dict. words」; 699m 是表中 Gigaword 一栏的数字. 正文很可能把两栏的数字混了, 应为 5.6M / 669M.

Slide 64

Example : Social media messaging norms

Original social media message
hey u free tmrw? wanna grab smth 2 eat b4 class?

Normalized version
Hey, are you free tomorrow? Do you want to grab something to eat before class?

社交媒体文本的规范化 (normalization): 把网络缩写和谐音写法还原成标准形式: u → you, tmrw → tomorrow, wanna → want to, smth → something, 2 → to, b4 → before; 同时补上省略的成分 (are you、Do you) 和标点. 规范化后, 为标准文本训练的工具 (词性标注、句法分析、NER) 才能正常工作.

(2004), Spelling Correction as an Iterative Process that Exploits the Collective Knowledge of Web Users., 'Proceedings of EMNLP 2004', Barcelona, Spain, pp. 293—300.

拼写变体可以多到惊人: 有统计说 Britney Spears 在搜索中出现过 1126 种拼法. 但正确形式通常比最常见的错拼高约一个数量级: 表中 albert einstein 4834 次, 最常见的错拼 albert einstien 525 次, 比例约 9.2 (已计算). Cucerzan & Brill (2004) 正是利用这一点: 从大量用户的查询日志中「集体」学习拼写纠错.

Confusion set 混淆集: 由都是正确词但常被混用的词组成的集合, 如 effect / affect, their / there / they’re. 这类错误查词典查不出来 (每个词都存在), 必须看上下文.

PDF S. 63–64

Other filtering steps

Filters on the document level:

  • Discard documents smaller or larger than a given size
  • Discard texts with too few content words, to eliminate pages containing mostly word lists or numbers
  • Eliminate unwanted web pages, based on list of words typical of those context

M. Baroni, S. Bernardini, A. Ferraresi and E. Zanchetta. 2009. The WaCky Wide Web …

Filters on the sentence level:

  • punctuation marks
  • link artefacts, menu item separators such as | or <
  • too many capital letters, digits, commas, colons etc.
  • sentence too short or too long

Erla Hallsteinsdóttir, Thomas Eckart, Chris Biemann, Uwe Quasthoff, and Matthias Richter. 2007. Íslenskur Orðasjóður - Building a Large Icelandic Corpus. In Proceedings of NODALIDA-07, Tartu, Estonia.

其他过滤步骤分两个层面:

  • 文档层面 (WaCky 语料的做法): 丢掉太短或太长的文档; 丢掉实词太少的文本 (多半是词表或数字表); 根据某类网页的典型词表剔除不想要的网页 (如色情、赌博网站).
  • 句子层面 (莱比锡语料库建冰岛语语料的做法): 按标点 (例如没有句末标点); 链接残留、菜单分隔符 (| 或 <); 大写字母、数字、逗号、冒号等过多; 句子太短或太长.

这些都是简单的启发式规则, 便宜, 能去掉大部分非自然语言的内容.

语言识别与字符编码
Language identification · Char Encoding

PDF S. 65 · Slide 70

Language identification

  • Goal: determine the language of a text
  • Motivation:
    • For language-specific processing (morphological analysis, POS tagging, etc.) it is necessary to know the language
    • For Web corpus building, pages written in a language which is not the target language have to be filtered out
    • To train language-specific or multilingual LLM model

Scripts

Elvis Presley was a rock star.(Latin script)
猫王是摇滚明星(Chinese script, “simplified”)
אלביס היה כוכב רוק(Hebrew)
وكان ألفيس بريسلي نجم الروك(Arabic)
록 스타 엘비스 프레슬리(Korean script)
Elvis Presley ถูกดาวร็อก(Thai script)

Source: http://translate.bing.com — Probably not correct — Slide from Suchanek

语言识别: 判断一段文本是什么语言. 为什么需要: ① 形态分析、词性标注等处理都是针对具体语言的; ② 建网络语料时要剔除非目标语言的网页; ③ 训练特定语言或多语言的 LLM 需要按语言配比数据.

不同语言使用不同的文字 (script): 拉丁字母、汉字 (简体)、希伯来字母、阿拉伯字母 (这两种从右往左写)、韩文、泰文. 例句都是「猫王是摇滚明星」的机器翻译, 幻灯片自己注明「可能不正确」: 例如韩文那句只是名词短语「摇滚明星猫王」, 不是一个句子.

Slide 71–74

Char Encoding: ASCII

100,000 different characters from 90 scripts ? → One byte with 8 bits per character (can store numbers 0-255)

How can we encode so many characters in 8 bits?

  • ASCII standard : Ignore all non-English characters

26 letters + 26 lowercase letters + punctuation ≈ 100 chars
A=65, B=66, C=67, …

Limitation: primarily supports English text.

Char Encoding: Code Pages

  • For each script, develop a different mapping (a code-page)
    • Hebrew code page: ...., 226=...,א
    • Western code page: ...., 226=à,...
    • Greek code page: ...., 226=α, ...
  • Most code pages map characters 0-127 like ASCII

Disadvantages:

  • We need to know the right code page
  • What about code-mixing ? We cannot mix scripts.

Char Encoding: HTML

  • Invent special sequences for special characters (e.g., HTML entities)

&egrave; = è, …

Disadvantage: Very clumsy for non-English documents

Char Encoding: Unicode

  • Use 4 bytes (24 bits) per character (Unicode)

...65=A, 66=B, ..., 1001=α, ...,

Disadvantage: Takes 4 times as much space as ASCII

Slide from Suchanek

字符编码要解决的问题: 世界上有约 10 万个字符、90 种文字, 而一个字节只有 8 位, 只能表示 0–255. 几种方案依次是:

方案做法缺点
ASCII只管英语: 大小写字母、数字、标点, 约 100 个可打印字符 (A = 65)基本只支持英语
Code page 代码页每种文字一张映射表, 0–127 和 ASCII 相同, 128–255 各不相同必须知道用的是哪张表; 一篇文本里不能混用几种文字
HTML 实体用特殊序列表示特殊字符, 如 &egrave; = è非英语文档写起来非常笨拙
Unicode (定长 4 字节)给每个字符一个唯一编号 (码位)空间是 ASCII 的 4 倍

代码页的问题是同一个字节在不同代码页里是不同字符: 读文件时用错代码页, 就会出现乱码 (德语里常见的 Ã¤ 就是 ä 的 UTF-8 字节被当成 Latin-1 读的结果). 这就是 Slide 50 预处理里「检测文件编码」的原因.

幻灯片小错 (ASCII): ASCII 是 7 位编码, 共 128 个码 (0–127), 其中 95 个可打印字符; 「26 letters + 26 lowercase letters」应为「26 个大写 + 26 个小写字母」, 还漏了 10 个数字.

幻灯片错误 (代码页): 三个例子里 226 对应的字符都不对. 用 Python 实测: 字节 226 在西欧代码页 (cp1252 / Latin-1) 中是 â (à 是 224), 在希伯来代码页 (cp1255 / ISO-8859-8) 中是 ג (א 是 224), 在希腊代码页 (cp1253 / ISO-8859-7) 中是 β (α 是 225). 想表达的意思 (同一个编号在不同代码页里是不同字符) 没错, 但具体数值是错的.

幻灯片错误 (Unicode): ① 4 字节是 32 位, 不是 24 位 (Unicode 码位最大 U+10FFFF, 实际只需 21 位; 每字符固定 4 字节的是 UTF-32 编码, 不是「Unicode」本身). ② α 的码位是 U+03B1 = 十进制 945, 不是 1001; 1001 (U+03E9) 是科普特字母 ϩ (已用 Python 的 ord('α') 和 chr(1001) 核对).

Slide 75–78

Char Encoding: UTF-8

  • Compress 4 bytes Unicode into 1-4 bytes (UTF-8)
  • Characters 0 to 0x7F in Unicode (0x7F=127)
    • Latin alphabet, punctuation and numbers

• 0xxxxxxx (hexadecimal) (7-bit binary) 8 bit, 1 byte
• A = 0x41 = 1000001 >>>> 01000001

  • i.e., put them into a byte, fill up the 7 least significant bits

Advantage: An UTF-8 byte that represents such a character is equal to the ASCI byte that represents this character.

  • Characters 0x80-0x7FF in Unicode (11 bits):
  • Greek, Arabic, Hebrew, etc.

Encode as follows: 110xxxxx 10xxxxxx (byte, byte)   ç = 0xE7 (231) = 00011100111 → 11000011 10100111

f0x6601100110
a0x6101100001
ç0xE711000011 10100111
  • Characters 0x800-0xFFFF in Unicode (16 bits):
  • mainly Chinese

Encode as follows: 1110xxxx 10xxxxxx 10xxxxxx (byte, byte, byte)

Decoding (mapping a sequence of bytes to characters):

  • If the byte starts with 0xxxxxxx => it’s a “normal” character 00-0x7F
  • If the byte starts with 110xxxxx => it’s an “extended” character 0x80 - 0x77F; one byte will follow
  • If the byte starts with 1110xxxx => it’s a “Chinese” character, two bytes follow
  • If the byte starts with 10xxxxxx => it’s a follower byte, not valid alone!

Slide from Suchanek / Slide modified from Suchanek

UTF-8 是变长编码: 每个 Unicode 字符用 1–4 个字节. 规则看码位落在哪个范围:

码位范围有效位数字节模式例子
U+0000 – U+007F70xxxxxxxA, f, a, 数字, 标点
U+0080 – U+07FF11110xxxxx 10xxxxxxç, ä, 希腊、阿拉伯、希伯来字母
U+0800 – U+FFFF161110xxxx 10xxxxxx 10xxxxxx汉字、日文、韩文、泰文、€
U+10000 – U+10FFFF2111110xxx 10xxxxxx 10xxxxxx 10xxxxxx表情符号 😀, 生僻汉字

编码方法: 把码位写成二进制, 按位数补足前导 0, 从左到右填进模式里的 x. 例 ç = U+00E7 = 231, 11 位二进制是 000 1110 0111, 前 5 位 00011 填进 110xxxxx 得 11000011, 后 6 位 100111 填进 10xxxxxx 得 10100111, 即字节 C3 A7.

解码: 看每个字节的开头几位: 0 开头 = 单字节字符; 110 开头 = 后面跟 1 个字节; 1110 开头 = 后面跟 2 个字节; 11110 开头 = 后面跟 3 个字节; 10 开头 = 后续字节, 单独出现是非法的. 所以 UTF-8 是自同步的: 从任意位置开始, 跳过 10 开头的字节就能找到下一个字符的开头.

最大优点: ASCII 字符 (0–127) 在 UTF-8 中的字节与 ASCII 完全相同, 所以纯英文的 ASCII 文件本身就是合法的 UTF-8. 实测 (Python 3.15):

for ch in ['f', 'a', 'ç', 'α', '中', '😀']:
    b = ch.encode('utf-8')
    print(ch, hex(ord(ch)), len(b), ' '.join(f'{x:08b}' for x in b))
f 0x66 1 01100110
a 0x61 1 01100001
ç 0xe7 2 11000011 10100111
α 0x3b1 2 11001110 10110001
中 0x4e2d 3 11100100 10111000 10101101
😀 0x1f600 4 11110000 10011111 10011000 10000000

幻灯片里 f、a、ç 三行的二进制都和实测一致.

幻灯片前后不一致: 解码页写 110xxxxx 对应「0x80 – 0x77F」, 而编码页写的是 0x80–0x7FF. 正确的是 0x7FF (11 位全为 1 = 2047).

幻灯片不完整: Slide 75 说 UTF-8 用 1–4 个字节, 但只讲了 1–3 字节的情况, 漏了 U+10000–U+10FFFF 的 4 字节模式 11110xxx (表情符号等), 解码规则里也缺「11110 开头 = 后面跟 3 个字节」. 另外 3 字节的范围不只是「mainly Chinese」, 还包括日文、韩文、印地文、泰文和 € 等符号.

原文笔误: 「0xxxxxxx (hexadecimal)」: 0xxxxxxx 是二进制位模式, 「hexadecimal」本该标在旁边的 0x41 上; 「the ASCI byte」应为 ASCII.

Slide 79

Language detection

(Beispieltext: „Elvis Presley ist einer der größten Rockstars aller Zeiten.“)

  • How can we find out the language of a document?
  • Different techniques:
    • Watch for certain characters or scripts
      umlauts, Chinese characters etc.
      But: These are not always specific, Italian similar to Spanish
    • Use the meta-information associated with a Web page
      But: This is usually not very reliable
    • Use a dictionary
      But: It is costly to maintain and scan a dictionary for thousands of languages
  • Using NLP libraries to detect language or using SOTA LLMs (!!!!)

Slide from Suchanek

语言识别的几种方法和各自的问题:

  • 看特定字符或文字: 变音符 (ä ö ü → 德语)、汉字 → 中文. 但这些特征不总是唯一的: 意大利语和西班牙语用的字母几乎一样; 汉字也出现在日文里.
  • 看网页的元信息 (HTML 里的 lang 属性、HTTP 头): 通常不可靠, 很多网站随便填或根本不填.
  • 查词典: 看文本里的词出现在哪种语言的词典里. 但为几千种语言维护和扫描词典代价很高.
  • 用 NLP 库或最先进的 LLM: 现在的标准做法. 常用的库 (如 fastText 的 lid.176、CLD3、langdetect) 基于字符 n-gram 统计: 每种语言有典型的字母组合 (德语 sch、ung; 英语 th、ing), 短短一句话就足以判断.

Different IE approaches work with different types of sources

Slide from Suchanek

按结构化程度, 数据源分四类, 越往下抽取越难:

类型例子文件格式抽取要做什么
结构化学者引用数表TSV (制表符分隔)、CSV (逗号分隔)只需转换格式、对齐字段名 (Number → Citations)
半结构化CD 目录XML、YAML标签已标明含义, 按标签取值, 必要时合并 (firstName + lastName → Artist)
「非结构化」摩纳哥历史的段落HTML、纯文本、Word 文档真正的 IE: 识别实体和关系 (「建立」事件, 日期 1215)
混合大学人员名录网页HTML 表格里夹着自由文本表格结构给出字段, 单元格里的文本还要再抽取

「非结构化」加了引号, 因为自然语言文本也有结构 (句法、篇章), 只是不是数据库可以直接用的结构. 结论: 不同的 IE 方法适用于不同类型的数据源.

幻灯片错误: 结构化数据的例子里, 左边原表写 J. Smith 的数是 20934, 右边抽取结果却是 20937; 纯格式转换不应改变数值.

幻灯片错误: XML 例子里 </lastName> 后面关闭 artist 的标签写成了 <artist>, 应为 </artist>. 按原样这个 XML 不合法: 用 Python 的 xml.dom.minidom.parseString 解析报 mismatched tag.

Slide 84

Source Selection Summary

  • More data is often better... and there is a lot of Web data
  • We can extract from the entire Web, or from certain Internet domains, thematic domains or files.
  • The Web is free (if you are able to crawl it) but Web search queries aren't
  • We have to deal with character encodings (easy) and detect the language (still a challenge).
  • Our documents may be structured, semi-structured or unstructured.

Slide from Suchanek

数据源选择小结: ① 数据通常越多越好, 网络上数据很多; ② 可以从整个网络、某些网站域名、某个主题领域或某些文件中抽取; ③ 网络本身是免费的 (只要你爬得动), 但搜索引擎的查询不是 (API 收费、限额, 见 Slide 42); ④ 要处理字符编码 (容易) 并识别语言 (仍是挑战: 短文本、混合语言、相近语言); ⑤ 文档可能是结构化、半结构化或非结构化的.
